body.name: local ATE and leading-risk coordinates
body.construction: For every \(k,l\in\mathcal K_n\), put the local bias and the two conditionally centered stratum influence functions in the fixed-stratum direct sum \(h_{n,k}\); define \(\rho_{n,k}=\|h_{n,k}\|_n^2=\beta_{n,k}^2+\Gamma_n(k,k)\) and \(d_n(k,l)=\|h_{n,k}-h_{n,l}\|_n\).
